name: oberth
description: Oberth CI over MCP: /oberth:install for a new server, /oberth:connect for CA trust by pin, one events_wait kept open instead of polling, assisted-continuation holds serviced within their TTL, and the rule that an assisted run is never evidence.

url.title: Oberth MCP URL
url.description: MCP endpoint of your Oberth server, for example https://oberth.example.test:30443/mcp. Leave empty until a server exists: the plugin then guides you to install one (/oberth:install) or to connect to one.

ca_pin.title: CA SHA-256 pin
ca_pin.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the server's CA certificate. Leave empty before a server exists; /oberth:install records the installed connection and /oberth:connect checks its pin.
